The '''Galactic Senate Medcenter''', also called the '''Senate Hospital''' or the '''Galactic Center Medcenter''', was a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] located several stories below the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Constructed as a private and exclusive recovery and healing facility for the senators and bureaucrats; it was open day and night. During the era known to history as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], the medcenter's patients ranged from senators who had too much to drink to those injured in recreational activities like [[scoopball]].<ref name="COD" />

While general members of the populace were also admitted, they were quickly rushed out if a politician required immediate attention or high security, as in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] when [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was admitted to the Medcenter after the first attempt on his life by the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]].<ref name="COD" />

In [[44 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] was hospitalized in the Galactic Senate Medcenter following his attempted assassination.<ref name="FOTJA" />

==Layout==
Occupying the top five stories of a nondescript, mid-level building, the Galactic Senate Medcenter was accessible via [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] or by [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] access at one of the various species-specific entrances.<ref name="COD" /> Surrounded by [[Hospital Plaza]], civilian bombardment shelters were located at the base of the building, several hundred meters below the medcenter; the entrances were positioned right below the medcenter's main docking level. A [[Skybridge/Legends|skybridge]] connected the Medcenter with [[Embassy Mall]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>
